description: Resource schema for an EC2 Spot Instance request. This is a read-only resource representing one Spot Instance request record: cancelling a request neither terminates the instance it launched nor removes the record, so CloudFormation observes the request rather than owning its lifecycle.

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with a resource.

Key.description: The key name of the tag.

SpotInstanceStatus.description: The status code and status message describing the Spot Instance request.

Message.description: The description for the status code.

UpdateTime.description: The date and time of the most recent status update.

GroupIdentifier.description: A security group the Spot Instance request launches into.

GroupId.description: The ID of the security group.

GroupName.description: The name of the security group.

IamInstanceProfileSpecification.description: The IAM instance profile the launched instance receives. A request supplies either Arn or Name and the read view returns that one alone.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the instance profile.

Name.description: The name of the instance profile. A request specifies either Name or Arn, and the service returns whichever was specified.

MonitoringEnabled.description: Whether detailed monitoring is enabled for the launched instance.

SpotPlacement.description: The placement of the launched instance.

AvailabilityZone.description: The Availability Zone the instance launches in.

AvailabilityZoneId.description: The ID of the Availability Zone the instance launches in. The service derives this from AvailabilityZone; the two cannot both be supplied.

GroupName.description: The name of the placement group the instance launches into.

Tenancy.description: The tenancy of the launched instance.

EbsBlockDevice.description: An EBS volume the launched instance receives.

DeleteOnTermination.description: Whether the volume is deleted when the instance terminates.

Iops.description: The number of I/O operations per second the volume provisions.

KmsKeyId.description: The identifier of the KMS key used to encrypt the volume.

SnapshotId.description: The ID of the snapshot the volume is created from.

Throughput.description: The throughput the volume provisions, in MiB/s.

VolumeSize.description: The size of the volume, in GiB.

BlockDeviceMapping.description: A block device mapping the launched instance receives.

DeviceName.description: The device name exposed to the instance.

NoDevice.description: Suppresses the specified device included in the block device mapping of the AMI.

VirtualName.description: The virtual device name of an instance store volume.

LaunchSpecification.description: The launch specification the Spot Instance request was created with, as the service returns it.

BlockDeviceMappings.description: The block device mappings for the launched instance.

EbsOptimized.description: Whether the launched instance is optimized for EBS I/O.

ImageId.description: The ID of the AMI the instance launches from.

InstanceType.description: The instance type. Deliberately unconstrained: com.amazonaws.ec2#InstanceType is a 1405-member enum that AWS extends with every instance family, so a schema enum would reject a launch on a type newer than this schema. Every other Smithy enum behind a property here is small and closed and is constrained.

KernelId.description: The ID of the kernel. Only a paravirtual machine image uses one, so a request backed by an HVM image does not carry it.

KeyName.description: The name of the key pair.

NetworkInterfaces.description: The network interfaces specified inline on the request.

RamdiskId.description: The ID of the RAM disk. Only a paravirtual machine image uses one, so a request backed by an HVM image does not carry it.

SecurityGroups.description: The security groups the launched instance joins.

SubnetId.description: The ID of the subnet the instance launches in.

InstanceIpv6Address.description: An IPv6 address to assign to the network interface.

PrivateIpAddressSpecification.description: A private IPv4 address to assign to the network interface.

Primary.description: Whether this is the primary private address.

InstanceNetworkInterfaceSpecification.description: A network interface specified inline on the request. This form is mutually exclusive with the launch specification's top-level SubnetId, which the service omits from the read view when an interface is given.

AssociatePublicIpAddress.description: Whether to assign a public IPv4 address.

DeleteOnTermination.description: Whether the interface is deleted when the instance terminates.

Description.description: A description for the network interface.

DeviceIndex.description: The position of the interface in the attachment order.

Ipv6AddressCount.description: The number of IPv6 addresses to assign automatically.

NetworkInterfaceId.description: The identifier of an existing network interface to attach.

PrivateIpAddresses.description: Private IPv4 addresses to assign to the interface.

SecondaryPrivateIpAddressCount.description: The number of secondary private IPv4 addresses to assign automatically.

SubnetId.description: The ID of the subnet the interface is created in.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Spot Instance request.

AvailabilityZoneGroup.description: The Availability Zone group. Spot Instance requests sharing a group launch in the same Availability Zone.

CreateTime.description: The date and time the Spot Instance request was created.

InstanceId.description: The ID of the instance launched to fulfill the Spot Instance request.

InstanceInterruptionBehavior.description: The behavior when a Spot Instance is interrupted.

LaunchGroup.description: The instance launch group. Spot Instances in a launch group launch and terminate together.

LaunchedAvailabilityZone.description: The Availability Zone the request is launched in.

LaunchedAvailabilityZoneId.description: The ID of the Availability Zone the request is launched in.

ProductDescription.description: The product description associated with the Spot Instance.

SpotInstanceRequestId.description: The ID of the Spot Instance request.

SpotPrice.description: The maximum hourly price paid for the Spot Instance. The service normalizes this value to six decimal places, and returns the instance type's On-Demand price when the request does not specify one.

State.description: The state of the Spot Instance request.

Tags.description: The tags assigned to the Spot Instance request.

ValidFrom.description: The earliest date and time, in UTC, at which the request may be fulfilled. The service returns it for any request that supplied it.

ValidUntil.description: The end date of the request. A one-time request that does not specify one is valid for seven days from creation.
